encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

div.note: Athenaeus 4, 166 d Πολύευκτον Ἀναξανδρίδης ἐν Τηρεῖ κωμῳδῶν κτλ. 1. κεκλήσηι et 3. δῆτα Α.

— adparet Polyeuctum quoque ab Atheniensibus avem vocatum esse. cf. Arist. Av. 165 sq. 1290 sq. significatur autem Polyeuctus Sphettius, orator nobilissimus, de quo cf. Demosth. 9, 72. Dinarch. 1, 100. Plutarch. Mor. 841 e. Ruhnk. Hist. crit. or. lxxx. Saupp. Orat. Att. fr. 273. dissentit tamen Boehneckius Forsch. auf d. Gebiet d. att. Redn. 643. de gallinis gallorum victricibus cf. Aristot. H. an. 10, 49. Aelian. H. an. 5, 5.
Athenaeus 15, 691 a τοῦ Μεγαλλείου μύρου μνημονεύει . . . Ἀναξανδρίδης Τηρεῖ κτλ. μεγαλλίοισι et μεγαλλίου A. cf. Pherecr. 140.
